item.title: ‘Loyal, courageous and full of heart’: Branson bids farewell to K9 hero Tygo
item.description: BRANSON, Mo. — The Branson community is preparing to say goodbye to one of its most loyal public servants. The Branson Police Department announced Thursday, Dec. 11, that retired K9 Tygo will be peacefully euthanized Friday, Dec. 12, because of significant health issues. item.title: Man arrested for threatening El Dorado Springs Christian School
item.description: Rolland Comstock, 22, was arrested for allegedly making a terrorist threat to El Dorado Christian School in El Dorado Springs, Missouri, after an internet tip was made to the FBI National Threat Operations Center.

item.title: Former news anchor and Silver Dollar City PR Director dies at age 64
item.description: Lisa Rau, former Ozarks news anchor and Silver Dollar City Director of Public Relations, passed away at the age of 64, leaving behind a legacy of dedication to the Ozarks community and the City of Branson.
